fact_text: A Pakistan-Saudi Arabia agreement is expected to bring Saudi investment into Pakistan, which had stalled under the SIFC investment framework.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The market value of listed stakes held under the SIFC framework, including OGDC, PPL, National Bank and possibly MARI, has risen to above USD 66 billion.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The analyst says Pakistan has macroeconomic stability but no growth drivers yet, and living standards will not improve until farm and industrial growth comes through.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The latest large-scale manufacturing (LSM) figures showed a slight improvement, though the analyst sees much room for further gains.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The CEO of the newly formed National Resources company said up to USD 5.5 billion of investment could flow into Pakistan's minerals sector, including rare-earth mining in Chagai.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Mari Energies is named as one of the listed companies with a role in the new national resources venture, which the analyst expects to appear in its books eventually.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Lucky Cement is also linked to the national resources venture, and the analyst expects that exposure to show up in the company's accounts over time.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: A mini budget of about PKR 50 billion in new taxes is being discussed, including a proposed 5% levy on imported electronic goods such as phones, gadgets and appliance supplies.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Pak Elektron, a Lahore-based appliance maker, also exports grid stations, electric meters and transformers, and imports inputs such as copper for its manufacturing.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The analyst expects Pak Elektron to gain from the proposed 5% electronics levy, because it is a strong local player in appliances.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The analyst expects Pak Elektron's sales to rise from about PKR 70 billion to above PKR 100 billion, and says its 2025 earnings outlook looks better than before.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The analyst says Pak Elektron's price-to-sales multiple looks reasonable on the broker's own website figures.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Under the mini budget the cigarette pack price rises to PKR 50, and the extra revenue goes to the federal government rather than to the provinces.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Cars with engines above 1800cc are also subject to levies under the mini budget being discussed.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The analyst links the mini budget to an FBR revenue shortfall against IMF targets, which he attributes to a weak economy and to floods.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: Higher regulatory duties on imported steel could benefit local steel makers such as Mughal Iron & Steel and Amreli Steels, in the analyst's view.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The analyst says Searle could get a boost if payments for a business it sold, on which it booked a loss, are received, and that management changes could bring growth.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)

fact_text: The analyst recalls that FDA approval and biosimilar news drove Searle's development under a former chairman, but those developments did not turn into growth.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Midday Flash 18 Sep 2025 | Mini Budget 50Bn Impact | SEARL, PAEL, MARI & Lucky Cement Analysis | PSX' (YouTube, 2025-09-18)
